# cycle_hub_roles (Data Source)

Retrieves all roles defined on the current Cycle hub, including the built-in default roles and any custom roles (`/v1/hubs/current/roles`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every role on the current hub.
data "cycle_hub_roles" "all" {}

# Find the built-in owner role's ID.
output "owner_role_id" {
  value = one([for role in data.cycle_hub_roles.all.roles : role.id if role.root])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The list of roles on the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `all_capabilities` (Boolean) Whether this role has every platform capability.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) The specific capability identifiers granted to this role. Empty when `all_capabilities` is `true`.
- `default_role` (String) The identifier of the built-in default role this role was created from, or null for fully custom roles.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the role.
- `identifier` (String) The slug identifier of the role.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the role.
- `rank` (Number) The hierarchy rank of the role (0-10).
- `root` (Boolean) Whether this role has full moderation control over all other roles.
